This is a bar chart displaying a time series of data from January 2019 to January 2022. The Y-axis represents numerical values ranging from 0 to 140,000, while the X-axis represents time in monthly intervals. The chart shows a single data series, indicating a peak in early 2020 followed by a gradual decline through early 2022. Key takeaway: The data shows a period of growth leading up to a peak in early 2020, followed by a sustained downward trend.


Source: Department of Employment, Thailand (2022)
